story_title: As an Event Operations Manager, I want to assign an Event Coordinator to an event so that there is a clear person responsible for coordinating it

acceptance_criteria.text: An authorised user can assign a coordinator to an event.
The Event Operations Manager can view or filter submitted events that do not yet have an assigned coordinator.
The assigned coordinator is recorded against the event.
The assigned coordinator can view and manage the event.
The Event Organiser can see the assigned coordinator where appropriate.
An event can be reassigned to another coordinator.

open_questions: NOTE: SPM-30 is not implemented yet. The Assignments page (src/app/assignments/page.tsx) is a 'not built yet' placeholder and there is no assignment endpoint. Steps follow the S-28 Assignment Queue mockup (design/mockups/AssignmentQueue.dc.html) and must be re-checked against the built UI (button labels, messages, reassign controls).

NOTE: Test data comes from scripts/seed-spm30.ts (npm run fixtures:spm30). It only deletes and recreates events whose seed key starts with 'spm30_'; the rest of the database is untouched. Run it before a full pass (TC01-TC19 run in order from fresh fixtures) and again afterwards to reset.

NOTE: TC20 (empty state) needs zero unassigned submitted events in the whole database, which on the shared database means assigning base-seed events such as 'Nusantara Developer Summit'. The fixture script does not restore those. Run TC20 on a Neon branch or local database.
NOTE: Organisers from an unrelated company not seeing the event is covered by SPM-31 (visibility), so it is not repeated here.
RESOLVED 2026-09-28: Only the Event Operations Manager can assign or reassign a coordinator (no self-assignment).

RESOLVED 2026-09-28: Assigning a coordinator moves the event from Submitted to Under review (TC08). So a Submitted event never has a coordinator, and filtering the Ops Manager dashboard's 'Awaiting assignment' section on status Submitted is enough.

RESOLVED 2026-09-28: Reassignment is available from both the event detail page (TC13) and the Assignments page (TC15). The mockup has no Assignments view for already-assigned events yet; re-check TC15's steps once built.
RESOLVED 2026-09-28: Events can be reassigned in any active status (Under review, Approved, Planning, Confirmed, Postponed), not Completed, Cancelled or Rejected (TC16, TC17).

RESOLVED 2026-09-28: The owning organiser and organisers from the same client organisation see the assigned coordinator at any non-draft status, with 'Not yet assigned' shown until then (TC06, TC10, TC11).

RESOLVED 2026-09-28: Remove the 'any coordinator can manage an unassigned event' allowance (TC07). This requires changing isAssignedCoordinator in src/lib/permissions.ts and updating docs/PERMISSIONS.md ('Assigned' relationship and Open items).

RESOLVED 2026-09-28: On assignment the new coordinator is notified; on reassignment both the new and previous coordinators are notified; the organiser is not notified. No test cases yet because the Notifications page (S-04, SPM-53) is still a placeholder, so a tester cannot see notifications on screen. Add them once SPM-53 is built.

RESOLVED 2026-09-28: The mockup's 'Coordinator workload' panel is not a requirement. Customer clarification #93: choosing a coordinator 'is up to Event Operations Manager, they have their own SOP which is handled outside of the system'. #92: a coordinator can be assigned to multiple events concurrently (no cap). No Jira story covers it. Out of scope for SPM-30; no test cases.

CONFIRMED by customer clarifications (docs/discussions/20260916): #94 and #101 - only the Event Operations Manager assigns and reassigns, as a separate role, and reassignment approval happens outside the system; #95 - no acceptance step, the assignment takes effect immediately (TC09); #81 - organisers in the same client organisation may view each other's events (TC11); #117 - the Ops Manager must be able to identify newly submitted events needing assignment, without a notification per submission (TC01, TC02).
